findings.passage: It's important that every person can trust that our elections are conducted fairly and transparently.
findings.note: Opening line of his answer in a Green Bay Press-Gazette candidate Q&A (question: what Wisconsin should do to protect the democratic process and ensure the integrity of its elections). No mention of ID in the part read.
